field_model: conditional; unverified geometric-center to odom-origin equivalence
heading: nominal room +X at start; 5deg inherited prior, not calibrated heading uncertainty
initialization: first 5s after recorded start stable begins; four-wall nonlinear least squares only; no manual XY used by estimator
clock: VM bag receipt association; preserve original header and prefix availability; no physical clock calibration claim
odom: latest arrived receipt at/before state time; max age 0.5s; skip frame if either missing; retain actual cumulative XY and quaternion yaw
gyro: published Z engineering axis; left hold max100ms; no complete angular factor on any gap; no odom angular fallback
weights: unchanged inherited engineering weights and zero range corrections, not calibrated probabilities
peer: car1 node_0 only; reverse direction not duplicated as independent factor
evaluation: all four manually measured stable windows; valid and failure coverage separate; no reference interpolation through motion
main_scope: first conditional dynamic development comparison; not independent validation, safety certification or novelty proof
heldout: do not read A2/B2 measurements or localization outputs in estimator development
limits: no parameter search, no new field collection, no old batch rerun; max1200s per cell CPU1
